theorems.name: Submission.tangentialDivergence_meanCurvature_integrableOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M F : Set (Rn N)) (Y : Rn N → Rn N), MeasurableSet M → ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M → ContinuousOn (meanCurvature M) M → (∀ C ⊆ M, IsCompact C → μHE[n] C < ⊤) → ContDiff ℝ 1 Y → IsClosed F → (∀ x ∉ F, Y x = 0) → IsCompact (M ∩ F) → IntegrableOn (tangentialDivergence M Y) M μHE[n] ∧ IntegrableOn (fun y ↦ inner ℝ (Y y) (meanCurvature M y)) M μHE[n]
